initial-dialogue.player: One of them? What do you mean?

initial-dialogue.npc: Hmm... It's none of your concern. Move along.
What's this game you're playing? Are you with them?

initial-dialogue.player: Right... Well, no, I'm not with them.

initial-dialogue.npc: Good. They've decided they don't like me too much, what with me killing about eight of them...

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has not completed Pandemonium:

steps.player: Yes, I can see why that might have upset them. Anyway, I think I'm going to head off now, but good luck with... everything.

initial-dialogue.player: Yes, I can see why that might have upset them. Perhaps it might be wise for you to put some distance between you and them.

initial-dialogue.npc: Is that you making me an offer?

steps.player: I'm afraid not. At some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with, but I'm not really ready for that yet.

steps.npc: Hmm... Well, maybe you should let me know when you are...

steps.text: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.

options.text: Well, I guess you could join my crew.

steps.player: Well, I guess you could join my crew.

steps.npc: Hmm... I don't know... You say you're not one of them, but I reckon you're trying to fool me!

steps.text: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 70 Sailing.

steps.player: Well, I guess you could join my crew.

steps.npc: Hmm... Dogs can't swim, can they? Yes... I think this might work...

steps.text: You recruit Jittery Jim as a crew member. He heads off in search of your boat.

subsequent-dialogue.player: I see you're still here. Do you not think it would be best if you put some distance between yourself and this place?

subsequent-dialogue.npc: Is that you making me an offer?

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: Hello there. How are things going?

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: Being on your crew is keeping me one step ahead of them, Captain, and that's all I ask.

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: It must be scary living in your own head...

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: The fear keeps me safe, Captain.
